name: Bases Link Graph
changes: Turn on Show arrows to see the direction of each link, and hover over a note to see its relations, such as parent or friend.
Pro can color links by relation, with a Links legend that the SVG export keeps.
tip: Right-click a node and choose Show only notes near this one to limit depth with Pro.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Link Graph is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
